name: AlgZoo longest-cycle transformer (hidden 6, length 5)
arch:
A 2-layer attention-only transformer: no MLPs, no LayerNorm, no biases, one head per layer, no attention mask (every position attends to every position). Vocabulary 5 tokens, sequences of 5 tokens, residual width 6.
  x = W_E[tokens] + W_pos                      W_E: 5 x 6, W_pos: 5 x 6
  per layer l: x = x + softmax(q k^T / sqrt(6)) v W_O,  q = x W_Q, k = x W_K, v = x W_V  (each 6 x 6)
  out = x[last position] @ W_U                 W_U: 6 x 5
378 parameters. The output is a score per class; the decision is the largest.
context: Each input is a function f on {0..4}: token i is f(i). Output class c stands for 'the longest cycle of f has length c + 1' (follow i -> f(i) -> f(f(i)) ... until it returns).

answer.short: length of the longest cycle of the input function, minus 1
answer.detail: AlgZoo longest_cycle, hidden 6, length 5, seed 2; accuracy 0.9469 on all 3125 inputs. No published interpretation found (searched Nov 17, 2026).

domain.text: Every possible input: all 5**5 = 3125 functions on {0..4}.
